note: Ingersoll-Rand plc (now TT) spun its industrial arm into Gardner Denver (renamed Ingersoll Rand Inc., IR): 1 HoldCo share per share x 0.8824 merger ratio (Trane Form 8937). Closes: Tiingo raw, Nasdaq agrees on both ex-date closes.

Arconic Inc. (now Howmet, HWM) spun off Arconic Corp: 1 share per 4 (Arconic Corp information statement). Arconic Corp sat in the S&P 500 at zero price from the 2020-03-31 close until it moved to the SmallCap 600 before the 2020-04-06 open (S&P DJI 2020-04-01).
United Technologies (now RTX) spun off Carrier (1 per share) and Otis (0.5 per share) the day it merged with Raytheon. UTX close 2020-04-02 from Tiingo raw; ex-date closes agree Tiingo = Nasdaq.
Fortive spun off Vontier: 0.4 per share (Fortive kept 19.9%). Vontier close 28.11 = Tiingo = Nasdaq (Yahoo's 28.28 is patched, see price_patches.csv).

Pfizer spun off Upjohn, which merged with Mylan to form Viatris the same day: ~0.124079 Viatris per Pfizer share (Pfizer release 2020-11-16); Viatris' first regular-way day and Pfizer's ex-date 2020-11-17.
Aimco spun off Apartment Income REIT 1:1 (AIR 8-K 2020-12-15). S&P: AIRC sat in the S&P 500 until it moved to the MidCap 400 before the 2020-12-21 open, when Tesla replaced AIV (S&P DJI 2020-12-11).
